g.text: FINAL YEAR PROJECT (FYP) — MULTI-AGENT MARKET RESEARCH PLATFORM (MARP)
COMPLETE UNIFIED RELATIONAL SCHEMA (ERD) • 3-STUDENT INDIVIDUAL WORK BREAKDOWN & RESPONSIBILITY MATRIX
User credentials, access control & profile records
Android field hardware devices, IMEI & security status
Tamper-evident system activity and security audit trail
Every query enforces company_id filtering preventing cross-company data leakage.
5 System Roles (Company Administrator, Research Manager, Analyst, Field Staff, Evidence Reviewer).
BCrypt password hashing with passlib and PyJWT bearer authentication tokens.
Unique IMEI/Android identifier authorization with remote deactivation and revocation.
Immutable audit logs recording actor, action, affected resource, client IP, and structured JSON metadata.
Sealed immutable JSON snapshots & version changelog
Single choice, multiple choice & dropdown items
Dynamic conditional logic engine (Show / Hide / Skip)
Short Answer, Long Answer, Single Choice, Multiple Choice, Dropdown, Rating 1-5, Photo, GPS, DateTime.
Configurable rules evaluate source question answer to dynamically show, hide, or mandate follow-up questions.
Stored translated texts with automatic right-to-left Nastaliq alignment in mobile preview.
Publishing seals an immutable JSON snapshot ensuring historical integrity of active field surveys.
Configurable demographic quotas (age, gender, target city) and SMS OTP carrier integration.
Competitor brand intelligence & market share entities
Deploy questionnaires to active research campaigns
Field photos, GPS coordinates & audit verification
Country → Province → City → Area → Site with self-referencing parent_id and GPS coordinates.
Exact dimensions, illumination (Frontlit/Backlit/SMD), orientation, photo references, and site association.
Tracks competitor brands, share of voice, footprint locations, and head-to-head comparison analytics.
Assigns active Field Staff members to campaigns, target locations, and questionnaires with scheduled deadlines.
Reviewer approval/rejection pipeline for uploaded photo evidence, GPS tags, and surveyor notes.
